name: per-phase-timing-report
body: `apg scan` must report a per-phase timing breakdown — frontend, ingest-assembly, DB-load, startup/overhead — as first-class output (log line and/or machine-readable), so wins B and C can be measured against the recorded full-scan baseline. AC: a scan prints each phase's duration; a no-op fast-path scan reports that the frontend phase was skipped.
